NEOEN is proposing to establish a 400-megawatt (MW) lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) facility adjacent to 752 CONCESSION 2 (Saugeen Township), to support Ontario’s electricity reliability needs through a contract with the Independent Electricity System Operator (IESO).  A zoning by-law amendment is needed to change the zoning on a portion of the property to permit the use.
Recommendation:
That the report regarding Zoning By-law Amendment - Z-2026-028 by NEOEN be received for information.

This report provides an overview of the proposed Community Planning Permit System (CPPS), summarizes feedback received through the public consultation process, and outlines recommended amendments to the draft CPPS By-law and Official Plan Amendment. The report also seeks Council direction to proceed with the CPPS initiative and requests endorsement of a public engagement framework for future Heritage and Community Character Official Plan work proposed for 2027.
Recommendation:
That Council direct staff to advance the Community Planning Permit System, incorporating the modifications identified in this report, at the December 21, 2026 Planning Council meeting; and,
That Council endorse the proposed public engagement framework for the Heritage and Community Character Official Plan Amendment.
